page: OVHcloud d2-8 is an entry-level virtual server belonging to the Discovery family, running on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Haswell processor clocked at 2.0 GHz. The configuration provides 4 vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with a shared CPU allocation model and no hyperthreading. Memory capacity is set at 8.0 GB, yielding 2.0 GB of RAM per core. Local storage is bundled and consists of a 50 GB NVMe SSD, while the network baseline bandwidth is rated at 0 Gbps. A single complimentary public IPv4 address is included.

Benchmark results indicate modest performance characteristics across both compute and memory subsystems. In stress-ng testing, the single-core CPU performance scored 917.98, while multi-core performance reached 3730.94. Memory bandwidth tests showed 322.39 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 35.67 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. Cryptographic and compression workloads also reflect these limitations, with a single-threaded bzip3 decompression speed of 6.92 GB/sec and a Passmark CPU encryption score of 949.1.

Given the shared CPU allocation and older Intel Haswell architecture, this instance exhibits a clear tradeoff between raw processing power and cost efficiency. It is positioned as a budget-friendly option for non-critical workloads where resource density and low cost are prioritized over high-performance guarantees. The server is best suited for lightweight applications such as basic static web serving, development environments, small-scale testing, and simple database operations that do not require sustained high CPU utilization.
